text: A股主要指数今日集体上涨，截至收盘，沪指涨1.08%报3638.03点，深证成指涨1.63%，创业板指涨1.87%，北证50涨0.58%，科创50指数涨3.11%。全市场成交额17952亿元，较上日放量1075亿元，全市场超4600只个股上涨。 盘面上，国产AI漫剧海外爆火，AI视频概念爆发，芒果超媒、果麦文化20CM涨停，掌阅科技、视觉中国等十余股10CM涨停；券商股集体上涨，国金证券、太平洋涨停，三大监管部门据报召集重磅会议；白酒股表现强势，水井坊、金种子酒、皇台酒业涨停，贵州茅台重回1400元创逾半年新高，Q3净利环比增15%；游戏、软件开发、教育
text_en: Major A-share indices rose collectively today. As of the close, the Shanghai Composite rose 1.08% to 3,638.03 points, the Shenzhen Component rose 1.63%, the ChiNext Index rose 1.87%, the BSE 50 rose 0.58%, and the STAR 50 Index rose 3.11%. Market-wide turnover was 1,795.2 billion yuan, up 107.5 billion yuan from the previous day, with more than 4,600 stocks across the market advancing. On the board, domestically produced AI animated dramas went viral overseas, the AI video concept surged, with Mango Excellent Media and Guomai Culture hitting the 20% daily limit and more than ten stocks including Zhangyue Technology and Visual China hitting the 10% daily limit; brokerage stocks rose collectively, with Sinolink Securities and Pacific Securities hitting the daily limit, as the three major regulatory authorities reportedly convened a high-level meeting; liquor stocks showed strong performance, with Swellfun, Jindongzi Liquor and Huangtai Liquor hitting the daily limit, while Kweichow Moutai regained 1,400 yuan to hit a more than half-year high, with Q3 net profit up 15% quarter-on-quarter; gaming, software development, education
